title: Debt Mutual Funds & Fixed Income Allocation Principles
content: Debt mutual funds invest in government securities, treasury bills, commercial papers, and corporate bonds. Primary debt sub-categories: 1. Liquid & Overnight Funds: Low duration, minimal interest rate risk, ideal for emergency funds. 2. Banking & PSU / Corporate Bond Funds: Higher yield with high credit rating safety. 3. Target Maturity Funds: Fixed maturity matching investor investment horizons to mitigate interest rate volatility.
